notes: Quarantines only canonical weapon Items with an invalid persisted system.identifier on Foundry builds older than 14.368.
Prevents Weapon Readiness, Weapon Catalog, Weapon Economy, and the final stale-card sweep from touching those malformed legacy Items on affected core builds.
Leaves HMG, MA70, or any equivalent malformed firearm unchanged instead of triggering repeated dnd5e SchemaField validation errors.
On Foundry 14.368 or newer, the quarantine automatically lifts and the existing identifier repair path may run.
No gameplay mechanics, manufacturer automation, observer behavior, prices, or balance values are changed.
